results.title: Switch Flip #1
results.author: IanStarGem
results.description: Switch Flip #1. Modify/use however you want. Recorded with a ZOOM H4n using built-in stereo mics. Edited & processed with FL Studio 11 & Edison. Recorded at an inactive Ski-Lift. Technically the original sound was not a switch, it was a rain-proof cover on a power outlet. If you use this in anything, please put it in the comments, me and other people may want to check it out!

results.title: Click?.mp3
results.author: golakersri23
results.description: A short, sharp clicking sound lasting about 1 second. It has a mechanical, high-pitched, percussive quality but is not a pen click, keyboard, car door, airplane cabinet, child lock, glove box, nail gun, or stamp. The sound is dry (no echo), suggesting it comes from a small, solid object or mechanism. Could be a latch, button, or a small snapping mechanism. Do you know what it is?

results.title: Door closing, modern apartment, springy #15
results.author: JapanYoshiTheGamer
results.description: The sound of me closing a door in my apartment. Smooth hinges with no creaking. You can hear the springy latching mechanism when it shuts completely. One of 15 takes; there are also 15 takes of opening this same door.
